subject: lavaan WARNING: correlation between variables is (nearly) 1.0

messages.author: 1c3692141a28424e
messages.subject: lavaan WARNING: correlation between variables is (nearly) 1.0
parts:
Hi everyone,

I run a sem function for mediation analysis, and I got the warning in lavaan 
lavaan WARNING: correlation between variables stn and intake is (nearly) 1.0. Here stn is my dependent variable with two categories (1/2), and intake is the continuous depend variable. Should I worry about this warning?

Thanks,
Francio

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: lavaan WARNING: correlation between variables is (nearly) 1.0
parts:
Sounds like stn=1 and stn=2 have intake values that nearly do not overlap.  When they do not overlap at all, then the variables are redundant, so you can't fit a model to it.  

https://stats.idre.ucla.edu/other/mult-pkg/faq/general/faqwhat-is-complete-or-quasi-complete-separation-in-logisticprobit-regression-and-how-do-we-deal-with-them/
